application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

units_released.note: Rule: one series string: in each period the current is identical in all 30 eight-cell groups (scripts/checks/source_audit/li2026_xie_schaeffer_zhou2026/check_li2026_audit.py); the paper refers to stations in the plural and gives no count. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: one cell per measured cell channel in the release
cells_liion.note: The paper states 200 cells; the release holds 240 cell channels, and the release value is used in every total.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

energy_mwh.source: 240 measured cell channels x 200 Ah x 3.25 V / 1,000,000; cell rating from https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xcrp.2026.103210, supplemental Table S1 (mmc1 p. 2, energy storage station column)
energy_mwh.note: The paper states 200 cells, which would give 0.130 MWh; the release holds 240 cell channels, so 240 is used.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from stated configuration

span_unit_years.note: Filenames use sample indices and the release has no calendar timestamps.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: the release contains no labels; the paper reports ESC, SDF and ICF events in the station data (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xcrp.2026.103210, p. 3-4)

sentinels_documented.source: https://zenodo.org/records/18471156; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
